Sliced by the facilitator and PM 2026-10-27; any seat may challenge it.
- **Depends on:** 085
- **Story:** As Riley, I want a docs-in-context mode in the benchmark harness that puts docs/GRAMMAR.md and the orders.phrase example, verbatim, into the prompt, so that I can measure what a cold agent does with the documentation it would really get, and the documentation tokens are counted.
- **Acceptance criteria (Given/When/Then; at most 3, each failing on partial work):**
  1. Given one task, When a model is run in docs-in-context mode, Then its prompt includes docs/GRAMMAR.md and the orders.phrase example verbatim, and the stored row records mode docs-in-context, the docs hash and the prompt hash
  2. Given the existing zero-shot rows in bench/results/history.jsonl, When the suite changes, Then they are kept byte-for-byte and are labeled mode zero-shot (a legacy row without the field reads as zero-shot), never relabeled as the new baseline
  3. Given a docs change, When the benchmark is re-run, Then the docs hash differs and the new row is comparable with the stored row for the same task and model; the docs tokens are added to the row's total tokens
